verdicts.reason: A buries the CTA: 'RSVP Free' has shrunk to a pill the same size as the three badges. Its six cramped columns (huge two-line headline, subtitle, date, tiny legal text) leave no clear reading order, the 'SOLSTICE' logo is broken up by a decorative dot, and the missing-image placeholder sits at the bottom right. B keeps a clear one-line headline and a large, prominent RSVP button in a sensible right-hand column, but the FREE ENTRY and ALL AGES pills visibly collide, the missing-image placeholder is cut off at the top-right edge, the legal text floats loose under the subtitle, and the lower left is dead space.
